title: Episode 77 — Gulab Rai Usurps the Guru’s Seat

blocks.text: Episode 77 opens by accusing Gulab Rai of causing rupture instead of preserving the Guru’s legacy, because he stirred strife with the Khalsa while claiming honours that were never his to take.
The strongest charge is that he occupied the Guru’s seat at Anandpur, and the text treats placing his feet on it as a public sacrilege rather than a mere political mistake.

His purchase of sixty villages and his attempt to gather followers around himself deepen the accusation, since he started holding his own congregations and tried to rival the Khalsa with landed authority.
